findings.reason: Half-width ': ' after CJK prose in two labels of one details block. The zh-CN guide (§Punctuation & typography) mandates the full-width ：, the shipped zh-CN catalogues write 293 full-width colons after CJK and zero half-width, the third label in this same block already reads 来源：{name}, and this wave's own new labels all use ：(目标：, 循环：, 问题：, 你：, 受阻：, 取消唤醒：). Shipped ui.agents.models.reading.model_cell writes the identical label as 模型：{value}. Both keys are PRE-EXISTING (unchanged from HEAD); it is recorded because this wave's new values contradict it, so the namespace would otherwise ship two spellings of one label form.
